name: Lien ~Owaranai Kimi no Uta~
source:
When I regained consciousness, it seemed I had died.
At first, experiencing things as a spirit (like, going through things) was somewhat fun, but I soon got a grip on myself.
Well, what to do now. It looks like a wild dream, but it's not as if I feel resentment or pain. I don't feel the necessity to achieve anything either. Even after becoming a ghost, I commute to school as usual.

Days pass by nonchalantly, but those days are forever lost to me.
Yet, even after having passed away, I'm remaining here. People I interacted with. New memories. A frozen flow of time. A running flow of time. In-between, I am in those maidens' everyday.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://www1.u-netsurf.ne.jp/~kai-m/review/review/lien_r.htm]Kのゲーム本箱[/url]]
translation:
當我恢復意識時，似乎已經死了。
起初，以靈體狀態經歷各種事情——比如穿過物體——還挺有趣，但我很快便冷靜下來。
那麼，現在該做什麼呢？這一切彷彿一場離奇的夢，可我既沒有怨恨，也感覺不到痛苦，更不覺得自己還有什麼非完成不可的事。即使已經變成幽靈，我仍像往常一樣去學校。

日子照常流逝，可那樣的時光對我而言已永遠失去。
然而，即使已經死去，我仍留在這裡。曾與我來往的人，嶄新的回憶，凍結的時間之流，奔湧的時間之流。夾在兩者之間的我，依然存在於那些少女的日常之中。

[略譯自[url=http://www1.u-netsurf.ne.jp/~kai-m/review/review/lien_r.htm]Kのゲーム本箱[/url]]
